home.title: deepseek-harness-cloud — cloud agents, no API keys
home.badge: Hosted accounts · sign in and go
home.h1: What should the AI do today?
home.sub: Describe the task and a cloud agent plans it, runs it and delivers — writing code, researching, running commands, producing results. The account, the credits and the model gateway are already set up. You never apply for an API key.
home.composer_placeholder: Describe a task, or just ask something…
home.composer_hint_in: Press Enter to run it in the cloud workspace
home.composer_hint_out: Press Enter to continue — it starts right after you sign in
home.check.browser: Works in a browser and on a phone
home.disclaimer: An independently operated commercial service. Not an official DeepSeek product.
home.two.title: Run it in the cloud, or on your own machine
home.two.lede: One account, one credit balance. The cloud saves you setup; the desktop saves you machine hours — and it still works when cloud capacity runs out.
home.two.cloud_title: Open a browser and start working
home.two.cloud_body: An isolated container per person, usable from a phone. Pages, reports and slide decks the agent produces open straight from the browser. {hours} machine hours a month, counted only while the agent is actually working.
home.two.desktop_title: Runs locally, costs no machine hours
home.two.desktop_body: Native macOS and Windows apps. Sign in and go — no API key to apply for. Tasks execute on your machine and only model calls draw credits, which works out cheaper for heavy use.
home.oss.title: Open source, and it fits inside your own network
home.oss.lede: The server, the desktop patches and the deployment setup are all open source. Deploy it once and you have a private dsh platform: accounts, quotas and the workspace all inside your own perimeter.

pricing.title: Pricing — deepseek-harness-cloud
pricing.lede: Credits are converted from upstream model list prices by usage, so you pay for what you use · Plan credits are valid for the current period · Credit packs are valid for 12 months
pricing.plan.intro_note: First month only · {price}/mo from the second month
pricing.plan.hours_note: (machine hours are separate and draw no credits)
pricing.tax_note: Prices are in {currency} and exclude tax, which is added at checkout for your location where applicable · Each period is paid up front, and nothing is charged automatically when it ends
pricing.workspace.lede_3: : credits pay for models and search, machine hours pay for the container your task runs in, much like CI build minutes. Each plan includes a different allowance (see the table above), and only the minutes the agent is
pricing.workspace.lede_5: are counted — reading a reply or leaving the page open costs nothing.
pricing.workspace.free_note: {hours} hours / month · included when you sign up
pricing.workspace.upgrade_note: Higher plans include more machine hours, along with more credits and more concurrency
pricing.workspace.pass_note_1: Buy this if you would rather not subscribe. Your first pass is discounted from
pricing.workspace.pass_note_2: Machine hours are unlimited while it runs, and it expires on its own without renewing
pricing.team.lede: Subscribe per seat and share credits across the organisation, or deploy the open-source code on your own machines.
pricing.team.seat_line1: Each seat includes {credits} credits and {hours} machine hours, pooled and shared across the organisation
pricing.team.seat_line2: From {min} seats · 10% off at 10 seats, 15% off at 25, 20% off at 50
pricing.team.seat_line3: Per-member usage is visible · you can cap each member
pricing.team.selfhost_note: Deploy the open-source code on your own servers. Data never leaves your network, and the upstream models are yours.
pricing.packs.lede: Prefer not to subscribe? Buy credit packs as you go; they stay valid for 12 months.
pricing.faq.a1: They are converted from the upstream model list price and settled on the input and output tokens you actually use, so you pay for what you use. Every line item is listed in the Console.
pricing.faq.q2: What is the difference between plan credits and pack credits?
pricing.faq.a2: Plan credits are valid for the subscription period (31 days on monthly, 366 days on yearly); pack credits are valid for 12 months. Whichever credits expire first are spent first.
pricing.faq.q3: What is the difference between credits and machine hours?
pricing.faq.a3_1: Two meters, and neither borrows from the other.
pricing.faq.a3_3: pay for model calls and web search, drawn by token usage.
pricing.faq.a3_5: pay for the cloud workspace container, counted by the minute like CI build minutes. A long task that barely calls a model spends machine hours and no credits; running models on Desktop Harness spends credits and no machine hours.
pricing.faq.q4: What happens when machine hours run out?
pricing.faq.a4: The task in flight is not interrupted, and the next one prompts you to upgrade. You can move up a plan (each tier includes more machine hours), buy a {days}-day pass, or switch to Desktop Harness, which runs on your own computer and uses no machine hours.

solutions.title: Solutions — deepseek-harness-cloud
solutions.h1: Pick the one that fits how your organisation works
solutions.lede: The first two decide where the system runs; the last two decide how you buy capacity. You can combine them: self-host one instance and still buy credit packs here for outside collaborators.
solutions.enterprise.title: Deploy it once and get your own private dsh platform
solutions.enterprise.body: The code is open source. Deploy it on your own servers or private cloud and you have a complete internal agent platform: accounts, quotas, the cloud workspace and the model gateway all sit inside your perimeter, and no data leaves your network.
solutions.enterprise.li1: A single docker compose command brings up the whole stack
solutions.enterprise.li2: Point the model upstream at your own — self-hosted, a dedicated gateway or a public cloud
solutions.enterprise.li3: The gateway exposes an OpenAI-compatible API, so existing code connects by changing one base_url
solutions.enterprise.li4: It can hook into your internal identity system, with usage accounted per department
solutions.teams.title: Subscribe by seat, with credits and machine hours shared across the organisation
solutions.teams.body: An admin buys seats and invites members. Everyone draws on one shared pool of credits and machine hours, and the console shows exactly who spent what. Nobody has to apply for their own model key or file their own expenses.
solutions.teams.li1: Seats are billed monthly or yearly and can be added or removed at any time, from {min} seats up
solutions.teams.li2: The shared pool stacks on top of personal balances, so joining a team never leaves a member with less
solutions.teams.li3: You can cap an individual member so that one person cannot drain the whole team
solutions.teams.li4: It fits handing out quota per person — teaching, research, outside collaborators: they get an account rather than a key, and it stops when the quota is gone
solutions.payg.title: Buy credit packs and spend what you use
solutions.payg.body: It works without a subscription. Credits are not wiped at the end of the month, which suits uneven usage or the occasional task. Every model is available — credits are the only gate, so there is no higher plan you have to buy before you can use a better model.
solutions.payg.li1: A one-off purchase, and the balance stays valid long term
solutions.payg.li2: Multipliers are benchmarked on Claude Sonnet at 1.00x, going as low as 0.044x
solutions.payg.li3: Desktop Harness and Cloud Harness draw on the same credit balance
solutions.subscription.title: Pay monthly or yearly, with monthly credits and cloud machine hours included
solutions.subscription.body: The best value when your usage is steady. Credits are granted each month, and cloud workspace machine hours are granted separately — neither draws on the other, and machine hours count only the minutes the agent is actually working.
solutions.subscription.li1: Four plans — Free, Plus, Pro and Max — starting at {hours} machine hours
solutions.subscription.li2: Yearly costs less than monthly, and you can move up or down a plan at any time
solutions.subscription.li3: Desktop Harness uses no machine hours, so heavy users can stay on the desktop and save them
solutions.contact.title: Need a self-hosted deployment or team seats?
solutions.contact.lede: Tell us your scale and your use case and we will suggest a configuration.
product.title: Product — deepseek-harness-cloud
product.h1: One account, four ways to use it
product.lede: One account and one balance, shared across the cloud, the desktop and your phone. The core is the open-source DeepSeek Harness; we add the hosted keys, the billing and the operations around it.
product.cloud.title: Start working in a browser, with nothing to install
product.cloud.body: Everyone gets an isolated cloud container where the agent reads and writes files, runs commands and installs dependencies. It works on a phone too: add the page to your home screen and it behaves like an app. Pages the agent builds can be opened on the public internet through My outputs.
product.cloud.check_hours: {hours} free machine hours each, and only the minutes the agent is
product.cloud.check_persist: Files and sessions are kept, so everything is still there when you close the browser and come back
product.cloud.check_idle: After {minutes} minutes idle the container pauses automatically and stops costing anything
product.desktop.title: Runs on your own machine and uses no cloud machine hours
product.desktop.body: Native macOS and Windows apps. Sign in inside the app, confirm the device in your browser, and you are ready to work. Tasks run on your own machine, and only model calls go through our gateway and draw credits.
product.gateway.title: An OpenAI-compatible API, with keys that never reach the client
product.gateway.body: Upstream model keys exist only on the server. The client holds a device token you can revoke at any time, and changing your password signs out every device. Usage is billed in credits in real time, and every charge is visible in the Console.
product.gateway.check_protocols: Both the OpenAI and the Anthropic protocol are supported
product.gateway.check_concurrency: Concurrency is capped by your plan; requests above the cap queue instead of failing
product.gateway.check_nocharge: Failed calls and empty results are not billed
product.search.title: Let the agent look up what happened today
product.search.body: Live web retrieval is built in. Results carry source links, so anything written into an answer can be traced back. You do not need a separate key for a search service.
product.cta.title: Want to run a task first?
product.cta.lede: Signing up gives you free credits and {hours} machine hours. No card required.
